title: Prayer of St. Francis (Peace Prayer)
attribution: Attributed to St. Francis of Assisi (Franciscan tradition)
notes: The famous Peace Prayer captures the spirit of St. Francis perfectly - his dedication to peace, poverty, and service to others. Though not found in his earliest writings, it embodies his spirituality and has become one of the most beloved prayers in Christianity. St. Francis is the patron saint of animals, ecology, and Italy.
